plugin.name: Testcontainers Data Sources
plugin.description: Automatically creates Database tool window data sources for containers started by Testcontainers (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQL Server, Redis, MongoDB) and removes them when the container dies. Requires docker CLI in PATH.
plugin.change-notes: New "Copy Connection As..." submenu on plugin data sources in the Database view: copy the connection as JDBC URL, ADO.NET / EF Core provider string (Npgsql, MySqlConnector/Pomelo, Microsoft.Data.SqlClient), or a ready CLI command (psql, mysql, sqlcmd, redis-cli, mongosh, pymongo); StackExchange.Redis config string.
